dishwasherBoosterConfigs.name: High-Capacity Dual-Tank Conveyor Dishwasher (240 Racks/Hr, Electric 27 kW Booster)
dishwasherBoosterConfigs.description: Standard high-throughput commercial conveyor machine with integrated 27 kW electric booster maintaining 180°F+ sanitizing rinse; fast pilot-operated solenoid creates severe Joukowsky spikes without arresters.

dishwasherBoosterConfigs.name: Institutional Flight-Type Continuous Conveyor (14,000 Dishes/Hr, Steam Coil Booster)
dishwasherBoosterConfigs.description: Massive banquet or hospital commissary flight conveyor; higher rinse flow rate and long stainless supply run generate massive kinetic momentum in the fluid column.

dishwasherBoosterConfigs.name: Compact Single-Tank Rack Conveyor (120 Racks/Hr, Gas Tankless Booster)
dishwasherBoosterConfigs.description: Mid-sized dining facility unit fed by dedicated high-efficiency gas tankless booster heater; sensitive to rapid pressure transients destabilizing gas flow modulation.

dishwasherBoosterConfigs.name: High-Temp Conveyor Glasswasher & Booster (160 Racks/Hr, Chemical Sanitizing Final Assist)
dishwasherBoosterConfigs.description: High-speed glasswasher utilizing rapid-pulse solenoid injectors for chemical sanitizer and hot rinse; small 0.5-inch thin-wall copper line subject to extreme wave velocity and solder shearing.

dishwasherBoosterConfigs.name: Legacy 22-Year Scullery Conveyor (Corroded Galvanized Feed, Sticking Solenoid Valve)
dishwasherBoosterConfigs.description: Aged dishroom installation with scale-constricted internal diameter, mineral-encrusted solenoid seat causing abrupt snap closures, and degraded mechanical hangers allowing pipe whipping.

solenoidValveClasses.name: Direct Pilot-Operated Diaphragm Solenoid (Standard Quick-Close, 20 ms)
solenoidValveClasses.description: Most ubiquitous commercial dishwasher solenoid; pressure-assisted diaphragm snaps shut in 15 to 25 ms, creating near-instantaneous momentum arrest in the supply line.

solenoidValveClasses.name: Two-Stage Cushion Soft-Closing Solenoid (Anti-Hammer Snubber, 120 ms)
solenoidValveClasses.description: Engineered anti-hammer valve with internal hydraulic snubber needle valve; smoothly ramps down flow velocity over 100+ ms, attenuating Joukowsky wave formation.

solenoidValveClasses.name: Direct-Acting Heavy Spring Plunger (Ultra-Fast Shutoff, 10 ms)
solenoidValveClasses.description: High-force spring plunger closure without pilot bleed delays; instantaneous closure delivers maximum possible kinetic shock wave into the piping tree.

solenoidValveClasses.name: Worn / Scale-Glazed Shuttle Solenoid (Erratic Water-Hammer Chattering, 8 ms)
solenoidValveClasses.description: Limescale accumulation on guide sleeve and hardened elastomer seal causes severe chattering and bounce-closure, generating repetitive compounding shock waves.

waterHammerArresterOptions.name: No Arrester Installed (Bare Rigid Plumbing to Valve Inlet)
waterHammerArresterOptions.description: Direct pipe connection without shock cushioning; 100% of the Joukowsky wave energy propagates directly into pipe walls, soldered elbows, and booster heat exchanger.

waterHammerArresterOptions.name: PDI Size 'A' Piston Arrester (ASME A112.26.1, 1-11 Fixture Units, 4.0 cu. in.)
waterHammerArresterOptions.description: Compact gas-charged piston or bellows arrester rated for small lines; partially dampens pressure surges on flows under 3.0 GPM.

waterHammerArresterOptions.name: PDI Size 'B' Heavy Commercial Arrester (ASME A112.26.1, 12-32 Fixture Units, 9.0 cu. in.)
waterHammerArresterOptions.description: Recommended standard commercial sizing for 0.75-inch conveyor dishroom lines; absorbs high-energy pressure wavefronts and keeps peak surge under 100 PSI.

waterHammerArresterOptions.name: PDI Size 'C' High-Displacement Arrester (ASME A112.26.1, 33-60 Fixture Units, 18.0 cu. in.)
waterHammerArresterOptions.description: Large-displacement stainless steel bellows arrester; virtually eliminates water hammer shock and safeguards booster tank weld seams.

waterHammerArresterOptions.name: Legacy Capped Pipe Air Crotch (Waterlogged / Ineffective)
waterHammerArresterOptions.description: Outdated vertical pipe capped stub; initial air cushion has dissolved into flowing water (Fick's law of gas absorption), leaving a rigid water column that provides zero protection.

plumbingGeometryProfiles.name: Engineered Sway Bracing & Rigid Clevis Hangers (Every 5 Ft, Rubber Isolation)
plumbingGeometryProfiles.description: Code-compliant mechanical pipe supports with neoprene vibration isolators; prevents lateral pipe displacement and reduces kinetic stress on soldered tees.

plumbingGeometryProfiles.name: Standard Un-isolated J-Hooks & Drop Wire (Every 8 Ft)
plumbingGeometryProfiles.description: Lightweight commercial installation allowing modest transverse flexing; produces distinct pipe clatter against studs during solenoid actuation.

plumbingGeometryProfiles.name: Unsupported 16-Ft Span Across Drop Ceiling (Unanchored Long Run)
plumbingGeometryProfiles.description: Excessive unanchored span; fluid deceleration causes severe pipe whip, hammering against drywall studs and accelerating copper fatigue failure at fitting shoulders.
